caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with a whole boiled egg and tender chashu pork, garnished with finely sliced green onions. Served in a white bowl on a wooden table, the warm lighting highlights the steamy, inviting meal.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned edges and visible marbling, irregularly shaped.
A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth and slightly glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and frothy, with visible noodle strands and floating green onions and red peppers.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle rim, and faint orange residue along inner edge.
